verdict.rationale: OpenCode has no documented training opt-out. It does let you control where code and prompts go: you can bring your own provider keys or run local models ([opencode-docs-2], [opencode-docs-53]), and the enterprise central config can force all users through your internal AI gateway ([opencode-docs-33]). That lets a lead keep data away from providers that might train on it, but only indirectly. A community report says telemetry goes to OpenCode's servers with no way to disable it ([opencode-comm-2]); that is about telemetry rather than training, but it weakens confidence in full data control. Missing for 10: an explicit OpenCode/Zen no-training data policy, a documented training opt-out setting, a way to disable telemetry, and independent verification of how data is handled.
